category: other: stir misdirected - blade kept beside or on the rim of the pot, pushing the pot instead of sweeping the vegetables

From ~550 to 1300 (~750 steps) the gripper stayed at the pot's right side with the turner hanging OUTSIDE the pot, next to its right wall over the exposed flame, while the handle slowly rotated in the fingers (width 0.024 at 480 -> 0.007 at 1296). causal_chain: first descent with the spatula (504-540) bumped the pot off the burner centre -> ~750 steps with the blade hanging outside the pot's right wall, never inside -> handle slowly slipped and the spatula fell at 1301 -> no stir counted
